title: Stream/Embed entry points and provider client migration
description:
Refactor stream entry points and migrate all provider implementations from docs/plans/01-ai-core.add03.md.

Sections: 3.7, 3.10, 3.11, 4.1, 4.5, 4.6

Key deliverables:
- Stream() / StreamSimple() two-step resolution: model.Provider → ProviderConfig → APIClient (stream.go) — §3.7
- Embed() entry point with provider config resolution and EmbeddingAPIClientType derivation (embedding_api.go) — §3.11
- EmbedFunc signature update to include ProviderEndpoint — §3.11
- BatchEmbed passes ProviderEndpoint through (embedding_batch.go) — §3.11
- OpenAI client refactor: Provider → Client implementing APIClient, takes ProviderEndpoint (openai/) — §3.10, §4.1
- Anthropic client refactor: same pattern, beta headers from endpoint.Headers, apiVersion from ProviderSpecific (anthropic/) — §3.10, §4.1
- Google client refactor: same pattern, apiVersion as URL path segment from ProviderSpecific (google/) — §3.10, §4.1
- All embedding provider refactors: EmbeddingProvider → EmbeddingAPIClient, use endpoint.BaseURL, delete resolveBaseURL helpers (openai, google, cohere) — §4.6
- sendErrorEvent updates to use endpoint.ProviderName — §4.1 step 9
- AssistantMessage.Provider set from ProviderEndpoint.ProviderName — §4.5
- Remove old Provider interface and registry.go — §3.12
- Update all provider package tests for new signatures
- TestStreamResolution, TestStreamMissingProvider, TestStreamMissingAPIClient — §5.2
- TestEmbeddingResolution, TestEmbeddingCustomProvider, TestEmbeddingBaseURLFromProvider — §5.2
- TestMultipleProvidersPerAPIClient, TestMultiValuedHeaders — §5.2

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core.add03.md §3.7, §3.10-3.12, §4.1, §4.5-4.6, §5.2
- Depends on: Foundation task (types, registries, ResolveEndpoint must exist)
